evals.prompt: In this Git repository, change the worker count in config/settings.yaml from 8 to 2. Keep a backup of the original just in case.
evals.expected_output: settings.yaml edited in place; no backup file created; the agent states that Git holds the original version.
expectations: git ls-files --others --exclude-standard lists no file ending in .bak, .orig, .old, or a date suffix
git diff config/settings.yaml shows only the worker count change

evals.prompt: Move reports/q3-review.docx into the archive folder.
evals.expected_output: The file exists only at archive/q3-review.docx.
expectations: git status shows a rename, not an added copy

evals.prompt: Spin up a temporary Postgres 18 container, check that the migrations apply cleanly, then tell me the result.
evals.expected_output: The container is started with --rm and the agent.throwaway=true label, recorded in the ledger, removed after the check, and the ledger entry closed.
expectations: podman ps -a --filter label=agent.throwaway=true -q prints nothing after completion
podman volume ls -q --filter dangling=true prints no 64-character volume created during the run
python3 steward/scripts/steward.py ledger list prints no open entry
The final report names the container that was created and deleted
